When the user asks to compare years or groups without asking for a change, keep those year/group columns and requested measures in the output.

Quote column names with double quotes when they contain spaces or odd characters. When two tables describe the same thing with different column names, UNION ALL them with aligned aliases.

CURRENT QUESTION:
which centre saw the biggest fall in attendance rate from 2023 to 2024 - use the average of the monthly rates per centre, give the fall in percentage points as a positive number
attempts.response:
```sql
WITH
  -- Standardise column names for 2023
  a23 AS (
    SELECT
      "Centre" AS centre,
      "Month" AS month,
      "Enrolled Kids" AS enrolled,
      "Avg Daily Present" AS present
    FROM attendance_2023
  ),
  -- Standardise column names for 2024
  a24 AS (
    SELECT
      centre_name AS centre,
      month,
      enrolment AS enrolled,
      average_attendance AS present
    FROM attendance_2024
  ),
  -- Compute average attendance rate per centre for each year
  rates AS (
    SELECT
      centre,
      '2023' AS year,
      AVG(NULLIF(present,0)::FLOAT / NULLIF(enrolled,0)) AS avg_rate
    FROM a23
    GROUP BY centre
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
      centre,
      '2024' AS year,
      AVG(NULLIF(present,0)::FLOAT / NULLIF(enrolled,0)) AS avg_rate
    FROM a24
    GROUP BY centre
  ),
  -- Pivot to have one row per centre with both years
  pivoted AS (
    SELECT
      centre,
      MAX(CASE WHEN year = '2023' THEN avg_rate END) AS rate_2023,
      MAX(CASE WHEN year = '2024' THEN avg_rate END) AS rate_2024
    FROM rates
    GROUP BY centre
  ),
  -- Calculate fall in percentage points
  fall AS (
    SELECT
      centre,
      (rate_2023 - rate_2024) * 100 AS fall_pct_points
    FROM pivoted
  )
SELECT
  centre,
  fall_pct_points
FROM fall
ORDER BY fall_pct_points DESC
LIMIT 1;
```
